questions.question: How many positive factors of 120 are there?
questions.solution:
The factors of 120 are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20, 24, 30, 40, 60, 120.

Hence, there are 16 positive factors of 120.

Hence, The correct answer is option 2.

__**Smart method**__

120 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 5 = 2³ × 3¹ × 5¹

Hence, number of positive factors = (3 + 1)(1 + 1)(1 + 1) = 4 × 2 × 2 = 16

questions.question: How many times the digit 2 appears in the first 100 natural numbers?
questions.solution:
The digit 2 in first 100 natural number is as follows:

Digit 2 in 1 to 10 → 1 times

Digit 2 in 11 to 20 → 2 times (12 and 20)

Digit 2 in 21 to 30 → 10 times (21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29)

Digit 2 in 31 to 40 → 1 times (32)

Digit 2 in 41 to 50 → 1 times (42)

Digit 2 in 51 to 60 → 1 times (52)

Digit 2 in 61 to 70 → 1 times (62)

Digit 2 in 71 to 80 → 1 times (72)

Digit 2 in 81 to 90 → 1 times (82)

Digit 2 in 91 to 100 → 1 times (92)

Digit 2 appears 20 times in first 100 natural numbers.

questions.question: If 727P is divisible by 8, then what is the value of P?
questions.solution:
Divisibility rule for number 8 = If the last three digits of a whole number are divisible by 8, then the entire number is divisible by 8.

The last three digit of number 727P = 27P

Now putting the value of P = 2, 4, 6, 8

⇒ 272 is divisible by 8

∴ 7272 is divisible by 8.

Hence, the value of P is 2.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a perfect square?
questions.solution:
From the given option, we notice that

1). 100 is the square of 10

2). 961 is the square of 31

3). 1521 is the square of 39

4). 776 is not the square of any whole number.

**Note: **Whole numbers are positive numbers including zero, without any decimal or fractional numbers.

Hence, 776 is not a perfect square.

questions.question: A and B can complete a work in 40 days, B and C in 60 days and A and C in 48 days. Who is the most efficient worker among A, B and C?
questions.solution:
Given, 

(A + B) complete a work in 40 days.

⇒ (A + B)’s one day work = 1/40

(B + C) complete a work in 60 days.

⇒ (B + C)’s one day work = 1/60

(A + c) complete a work in 48 days.

⇒ (A + c)’s one day work = 1/48

They together can do the work in, 

⇒ (A + B + B + C + A + C) = 1/40 + 1/60 + 1/48 = (6 + 4 + 5)/240 = 15/240

⇒ 2(A + B + C) = 1/16

⇒ (A + B + C) = 1/32

Now, A, B and C can do the work separately in, 

⇒ A = (A + B + C) - (B + C) = 1/32 - 1/60 = (15 - 8)/480 = 7/480 

A can do the whole work = 480/7 ≈ 69 days

⇒ C = (A + B + C) - (A + B) = 1/32 - 1/40 = (5 - 4)/160 = 1/160

C can do the whole work = 160 days

⇒ B = (A + B + C) - (A + C) = 1/32 - 1/48 = (3 - 2)/96 = 1/96

C can do the whole work in 96 days

Hence, A is more efficient than B and C, because he can complete the whole work in less time than B and C.

questions.question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 5 hours and 20 hours respectively. If both pipes are opened then, how much time (in hours) it will take to fill the tank?
questions.solution:
Pipe A can fill the tank in 5 hours.

⇒ Pipe A’s 1 - hour work = 1/5

Pipe B can fill the tank in 20 hours.

⇒ Pipe B’s 1 - hour work = 1/20

When they work together, the work will complete in, 

(A + B) = (1/5 + 1/20) = (4 + 1)/20 = 5/20 = 1/4

(A + B) can complete the whole work in 4 hours

questions.question: If the radius of sphere is reduced by 10% then what will be the percentage change in its total surface area?
questions.solution:
Let the radius of sphere be r.

Then the area of Sphere = 4πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0205ec9edea299ff1d2cf533fe33eec633c74690841c804ca20e5f3c6d2a31d.png] 

If the radius of sphere is reduced by 10%,

The new radius = r - 0.1r = 0.9r

New area of sphere = 4π(0.9)² = 4π(0.81)r²

Percentage change = frac{{4pi {r²} - 4pi ( {0.81} ){r²}}}{{4pi {r²}}} times 100

 = frac{{1 - 0.81}}{1} times 100 = 19 \%

questions.question: Marked price of an article is Rs. 3500. It was sold at a discount of 14.28%. If there was a loss of 20%, then what was the cost price (in Rs) of the article?
questions.solution:
**Short trick∶**

∵ 14.28% = 1/7

Required cost price = 3500 × 6/7 × 1/0.8 = Rs. 3750

**Detailed solution∶**

MP of an article = 3500

Discount = 14.28% = 1/7

Then, SP of an article = 3500 - 3500 × 1/7 = 3000

We know that, 

SP = CP + CP × Loss%/100

⇒ SP = CP + CP × 20%/100

⇒ SP = 80CP/100

⇒ CP = (100 × 3000) × 80 = Rs. 3750

questions.question: The cost price of an article is Rs 2500. Its price is marked up by 20%. If the article is sold at 15% discount, then what is the value of profit (in Rs)?
questions.solution:
Given, 

The cost price of an article = Rs.2500

Then, MP = 2500 + (2500 × 20/100) = 3000

Discount% = 15%

Then, SP = MP - (MP × Discount%)

⇒ SP = 3000 - (3000 × 15%)

⇒ SP = 2550

Now, 

Profit = SP - CP = 2550 - 2500 = 50

questions.question: A shopkeeper sold big, medium and small sized bulbs for Rs. 150, Rs. 80 and Rs. 50 respectively. The total number of bulbs sold were in the ratio of 2 ∶ 7 ∶ 11. What is the average price paid for a bulb?
questions.solution:
Let the total number of bulbs be 2x, 7x and 11x.

Then,

Total price of Big bulbs = 150 × 2x = 300x

Total price of Medium bulbs = 80 × 7x = 560x

Total price of Small bulbs = 50 × 11x = 550x

Average cost of bulbs = (300x + 560x + 550x)/20x = 1410/20 = 70.5

questions.question: If x ∶ y ∶ z = 3 ∶ 4 ∶ 9, then what will be the value of (2x + 3y + z) ∶ (2z + x - 3y)?
questions.solution:
Given:

⇒ x ∶ y ∶ z = 3 ∶ 4 ∶ 9

Let the value of x, y and z be 3a, 4a and 9a

Then the value of (2x + 3y + z) = 6a + 12a + 9a = 27a

 The value of (2z + x - 3y) = 18a + 3a - 12a = 9a

Ratio = 27a/9a = 3 ∶ 1

questions.question: Average age of A and B is 20 years. Average age of B and C is 18 years. Average age of A and C is 21 years. What is the average age (in years) of A, B and C?
questions.solution:
The average age of A and B = 20 years

The sum of age of A and B = 20 × 2 = 40 years

The average age of B and C =18 years

The sum of age of B and C = 18 × 2 = 36 years

The average age of A and C = 21 years

The sum of age of A and C = 21 × 2 = 42 years

The sum of age of A + B + C = (A + B + B + C + A + C) = 40 + 36 + 42 = 118

⇒ 2(A + B + C) = 118

⇒ (A + B + C) = 59

Average of A + B + C = 59/3 = 19.67

questions.solution:
Given, 

The selling price of toy = 25.5

SP = CP - (CP × loss%)

⇒ CP = 30

To get a profit of 25%, he should sell it for, 

SP = CP + (CP × profit%)

⇒ SP = 30 + 30 × 25/100 = 75/2 = 37.5

questions.question: A certain amount is invested in a scheme of simple interest. It amounts to Rs. 3600 in 5 years and Rs 4560 in 8 years. What is the rate of interest (in percentage)?
questions.solution:
Amount at the end of 5 years = 3600

Amount at the end of 8 years = 4560

∵ SI is same for every year

Increase in SI = 4560 - 3600 = 960

The simple interest for 3 years = 960

The simple interest for 1 year = 960/3 = 320

Simple interest for 5 year = 320 × 5 = 1600

Principal = 3600 - 1600 = 2000

We know that, 

SI = (PRT)/100

R% = SI × 100/PT

R% = (320 × 100)/2000 = 16%
